senses.gloss: ch. sameto rub (with oil), anoint; to rub off.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 12:20">Targ. II Sam. XII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 14:2">Ib. XIV, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:40">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 40</cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>סוך</he>); a. e.—
Pes. 25ᵇ דשָׁיֵיף לה וכ׳ as he was rubbing his (sick) daughter’s skin with undeveloped grapes of ʿOrlah.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 23b:5">B. Kam. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>דשָׁף צלמי</he> when the animal in scratching itself rubbed figures off (which were on the wall).—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01000"><he>שִׁיף</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01004"><he>שִׁיפָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 9:21">Targ. O. Deut. IX, 21</cite> (Y. <he>שפיית</he>, fr. <cite ref="U01735"><he>שְׁפֵי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 94:5">Targ. Ps. XCIV, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 14:19">Targ. Job XIV, 19</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:7">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>דשייף קליה</he>, v. <cite ref="U00004"><he>שְׁאֵב</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:5">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>שייפא בשופינא</he> (read: <he>שַׁיְּיפֵיה</he>; Ms. M. <he>שפייה</he>, fr. <cite ref="U01735"><he>שְׁפֵי</he></cite>) if he rubbed the stamp off with a file.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 30:8">Targ. Job XXX, 8</cite> <he>אִשְׁתּוֹפְפוּן</he> Ms. (ed. <he>ישתפפון</he>, v. <cite ref="U01793"><he>שְׁפַף</he></cite>).
